# ADR-3087: A08: CI provenance required key for deploy artifact 3

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Without provenance, builds can be swapped.

## Decision

Deploy pipelines SHALL attach a CI provenance required key for deploy artifact 3 (A08-3).

## Consequences

Attestations are verified before promote.
